existing_article_decision.nextAction: Run a paragraph-level source and terminology audit; any case example must be a separately reviewed source note, footnote, or linked case article.
existing_article_decision.forbiddenPromotion: Do not insert a modern case roster, direct quotation, allegation, settlement, denial, scientific assessment, or conviction language without the case-specific boundary.

point_records.heading: Полюби не Христа, а первое место
point_records.claimBoundary: Use only evidence of platform centrality, first-place ambition, and leader-centred identity; do not infer secret motives from fame alone.

point_records.heading: Считай церковь своей вотчиной, а не Божьим стадом
point_records.claimBoundary: Use documented personal-fiefdom, dynastic, financial-control, or ownership language; institutional scale alone is not proof.

point_records.heading: Болезненно защищай свой авторитет
point_records.claimBoundary: Use retaliation, defensive investigations, delayed truth, and reputation shielding; disagreement with a leader is not itself persecution.

point_records.heading: Избегай подотчётности и выстраивай автономию
point_records.claimBoundary: Use proven governance insulation and refusal of accountability. David Platt remains a no-merits procedural comparator.

point_records.heading: Собери рядом защитников, а не советников
point_records.claimBoundary: Use board capture, friendly investigators, and protective executive circles; ordinary loyalty is not evidence of corruption.

point_records.heading: Оставь множественность лидеров на бумаге
point_records.claimBoundary: Use records showing nominal boards, rubber-stamp structures, or leaders denied real access to information.

point_records.heading: Бойся сильных и одарённых рядом
point_records.claimBoundary: Use documented removal, suppression, or intimidation of capable challengers; personnel disagreement alone is insufficient.

point_records.heading: Называй удобных «зрелыми», а прямых — «сырыми»
point_records.claimBoundary: Use exact review findings or institutional records describing labelling, shaming, or discrediting dissenters.

point_records.heading: Преврати кафедру в карательный орган
point_records.claimBoundary: Use documented public denunciation, disciplinary theatre, or ministry channels used against critics; exclude Gray and Guay.

point_records.heading: Строй святую пропаганду и управляй картиной
point_records.claimBoundary: Use official reports on managed messaging, concealment, donor/public deception, and controlled disclosure.

point_records.heading: Управляй страхом, стыдом и доступом к благоволению
point_records.claimBoundary: Use safeguarding, court, or review findings linking spiritual authority to fear, shame, access, coercion, or grooming.

point_records.heading: Души церковь микроконтролем
point_records.claimBoundary: Use rule systems, invasive oversight, or adjudicated coercion; strict doctrine or discipline alone is not microcontrol.

point_records.heading: Поощряй нездоровое «открытие сердца» и собирай информацию
point_records.claimBoundary: Use documented private-access, confession, mentoring, or spiritual-intimacy mechanisms; do not generalise from healthy pastoral care.

point_records.heading: Дозируй правду, строй туман и управляй восприятием
point_records.claimBoundary: Use staged disclosure, incomplete statements, delayed communication, and acknowledged truth-management failures.

point_records.heading: Будь мягок с полезными, но суров с неудобными
point_records.claimBoundary: Use documented double standards, patronage, protection of loyalists, and punishment of critics.

point_records.heading: Оставляй за собой шлейф разрушенных отношений
point_records.claimBoundary: Use independent reviews or multiple named institutional records; do not convert anonymous dislike into a factual pattern.

point_records.heading: Объявляй любой серьёзный вопрос мятежом
point_records.claimBoundary: Use exact rebellion, slander, disloyalty, or immaturity labels applied to documented accountability questions.

point_records.heading: Ставь репутацию церкви и лидера выше истины
point_records.claimBoundary: Use institutional protection, donor/platform concerns, delayed reporting, or admitted failures; Shin concealment allegations remain blocked.

point_records.heading: Прячься за процедурой, формой и правильностью жалобы
point_records.claimBoundary: Use procedure as shield only where records show it. Platt remains a neutral-principles/no-merits comparator.

point_records.heading: Минимизируй зло и кайся так, чтобы ничего не менять
point_records.claimBoundary: Use exact institutional or self-admission chronology showing euphemism, partial confession, short-lived change, or delayed correction.

future_article_bundles.title: Диотрефы нашего времени
future_article_bundles.publicationBoundary: One power mechanism per case; preserve every case-specific legal and source boundary. No roster of guilt and no transfer of another person's crimes.

future_article_bundles.title: Дисквалификация, покаяние и пригодность к служению
future_article_bundles.publicationBoundary: Use official removal, confession and deposition records; distinguish forgiveness, membership, public platform and office qualification.

future_article_bundles.title: Неполное признание и преждевременное восстановление
future_article_bundles.publicationBoundary: Tchividjian is the incomplete-disclosure case; Noble is the positive-board/restoration contrast. Do not collapse them into one guilt category.

future_article_bundles.title: Когда «моральная ошибка» скрывает зло
future_article_bundles.publicationBoundary: Distinguish Savage's narrow admission, Woodson's allegation, institutional language, absence of criminal merits judgment, and later correction.

future_article_bundles.title: Звёздная платформа и оспариваемое злоупотребление властью
future_article_bundles.publicationBoundary: Adultery and termination are admitted; Kimes's abuse account remains allegation and Lentz's response remains denial. Final investigation report is unpublished.

future_article_bundles.title: Мировое соглашение — не приговор
future_article_bundles.publicationBoundary: Civil complaints prove allegations were filed; settlement and dismissal prove procedure, not liability. Senate inquiry is a separate accountability record.

future_article_bundles.title: Душепопечение, дисциплина и домашнее насилие
future_article_bundles.publicationBoundary: David Gray's conviction belongs to David Gray. Church knowledge, counseling and discipline require separate, contested treatment.

future_article_bundles.title: Обязательное сообщение и конфликт свидетельств
future_article_bundles.publicationBoundary: Authenticated correspondence proves words and positions; no adjudicator resolved Tucker's allegation against MacArthur's denial.

future_article_bundles.title: Институциональная память и научная переоценка
future_article_bundles.publicationBoundary: Use interim scientific probability language, not criminal-verdict language; final study remains pending.

future_article_bundles.title: Церковный авторитет и финансовые проекты
future_article_bundles.publicationBoundary: Proceeding ended by limitation without merits verdict. Pulpit-promotion claims remain attributed until authenticated primary media is secured.
